How Northwind Retail moved its pilot

Northwind Retail planned to start its checkout pilot in October. After two weeks of load tests the team chose to move the start to 18 November and keep the pricing page as it is.

What changed

  • The pilot starts in three stores instead of ten.
  • Lena Hartmann owns the data migration.

The full plan is in the pilot plan; questions go to the pilot desk.
